title: Designing Culturally Aligned AI Systems For Social Good in Non-Western Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with AI developers and domain experts to assess how real-world AI deployments overcome Western-centric defaults (e.g., generating culturally irrelevant educational examples) and adapt to regional contexts.

Qualitative evaluation of practitioner case studies documenting performance disparities in low-resource languages and local dialects, and the in-weight/in-context sociotechnical workarounds used to mitigate them.

Thematic analysis of developer interviews examining how system modalities, access mediums, and content were adapted to account for intersecting user disparities in gender, age, literacy, and socioeconomic status.
